description:
A Java Conversion Kit For Mac M1 / M2 / M3 Apple Silicon Chips

Descriptions:
Got Fancy New Apple Mac with M1 / M2 Chip On It?, How About Upgrading Starsector to run Natively on Apple Silicon Chips.
This Conversion Kit Allow You to Gain roughly from 30% up to 85% Performance Overhead thats loses due Rosetta Translation within MacOS enviroment.

Frequently Asked Question
Why I Do Need This?

Starsector bundled Java are for X86 Architecture which is what Apple used for their Prev Mac, This Conversion Kit Allow it to run smooth without needing additional Translator on-top to make it work seamlessly with less Overhead on Performances.

My Games Does Not Launch

Use your Backup & Redo everything because you accidentally merged it.. you'll need to move the files carefully otherwise Mac will remove everything else.

My Mac Have Built-in/Connected Retina Display, the Games Looks Blurry!

you'll need to navigate into Starsector.APP/Content and edit starsector_mac.sh then add this line :

-Dorg.lwjgl.opengl.MacOSXDisplay.enableHighDPI=true \

below -Djava.library.path=../../Resources/Java/native/macosx \
